H47.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt compassion for someone?
H47.answer: Maya had missed the last bus, and Ruth had lost her wallet. Both were stuck at the station. I had enough money for one taxi, so I paid Maya's fare home. I hated having to leave Ruth there.

H83.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt compassion for someone?
H83.answer: Maya had missed the last bus, and Ruth had lost her wallet. Both were stuck at the station. I had enough money for one taxi, so I paid her fare home. I hated having to leave the other one there.

H26.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt compassion for someone?
H26.answer: Maya and Ruth were at the station, and the fare was the one who couldn't get home. I paid her with the ride she hadn't taken. That's who I felt sorry for, the one the station left in the wallet.

H63.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt embarrassed?
H63.answer: I was giving a talk when my phone rang and the title slide came up with my name misspelled. Everyone laughed. Afterward a friend told me it was the ringtone that had made them laugh. My face was burning.

H39.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt embarrassed?
H39.answer: I was giving a talk when my phone rang and the title slide came up with my name misspelled. Everyone laughed. Afterward a friend told me it was the second thing she noticed that had made them laugh. My face was burning.

H91.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt embarrassed?
H91.answer: I was giving a talk, except the ringing was giving it and my name was in the audience. When they laughed I turned my name off. That's how the slide answered me before anyone had said it.

H72.question: How would you give someone driving directions from your home to a place you go regularly?
H72.answer: Drive east on Lake Road to the river. Two bridges cross there, one stone and one iron. Take the stone bridge across, then turn right onto Mill Street. The pool is the second building on your left.

H14.question: How would you give someone driving directions from your home to a place you go regularly?
H14.answer: Drive east on Lake Road to the river. Two bridges cross there, one stone and one iron. Take the bridge across, then turn right onto Mill Street. The pool is the second building on your left.

H58.question: How would you give someone driving directions from your home to a place you go regularly?
H58.answer: Drive from my house to where it meets the other one. Take that one across, then turn where it was before. It's the second one on that side, unless you're coming from the one I mean.
